name: Google Cloud IoT Core
tagline: Device registry and MQTT/HTTP bridge for connecting IoT devices to Google Cloud (service shut down).
description: Google Cloud IoT Core was a fully managed service for securely connecting and managing IoT devices at scale via MQTT and HTTP, with device registries, public-key authentication, and integration into Pub/Sub and other Google Cloud services. Google shut down Cloud IoT Core on August 16, 2023; the REST API and related endpoints are no longer available. Existing Google Cloud customers must use alternative IoT connectivity patterns (for example ClearBlade IoT Core as a migration path, or custom device-to-Pub/Sub architectures).

auth.details: Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 / service account credentials with Cloud IoT scopes (historical; service no longer accepts traffic).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Service discontinued; no active free tier
pricing.paid_plans: Service discontinued as of August 16, 2023; no paid plans available

use_cases: list device registries in a Google Cloud project (historical)
register an IoT device with public-key credentials (historical)
send configuration to a connected device via the device manager API (historical)
publish telemetry from devices to Cloud Pub/Sub (historical)
